local function PhysicsLoop()
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not active then
			TargetNameLabel.Text = "Target: None"
			DistanceLabel.Text = "Distance: --"
			
			local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
			if myChar then
				local myRoot = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if myRoot then
					myRoot.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
				end
			end
			return
		end
		
		local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
		if not myChar then return end
		local myRoot = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not myRoot then return end
		
		local v = myRoot.Velocity
		myRoot.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
		myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = flingVelocity
		
		for _, targetName in ipairs(targets) do
			local targetPlr = Players:FindFirstChild(targetName)
			if targetPlr and targetPlr.Character then
				local tPart = GetTargetPart(targetPlr.Character)
				if tPart then
					local dest = tPart.Position
					if Config.prediction.enabled then
						dest = dest + (tPart.Velocity * Config.prediction.lead_dist * (1/60))
					end
					
					local offset = Vector3.new(math.random()-0.5, math.random()-0.5, math.random()-0.5)
					myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(dest + offset)
					
					if Config.dz7_ai.enabled then
						myRoot.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(-99999,-99999,-99999)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		
		if #targets > 0 then
			local targetName = targets[1]
			local targetPlr = Players:FindFirstChild(targetName)
			if targetPlr and targetPlr.Character then
				local displayName = targetPlr.DisplayName or targetName
				TargetNameLabel.Text = "Target: " .. displayName .. " (" .. targetName .. ")"
				
				local tPart = GetTargetPart(targetPlr.Character)
				if tPart and myRoot then
					local dist = (tPart.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
					DistanceLabel.Text = string.format("Distance: %.1f studs", dist)
				else
					DistanceLabel.Text = "Distance: ?"
				end
			else
				TargetNameLabel.Text = "Target: " .. targetName .. " (invalid)"
				DistanceLabel.Text = "Distance: --"
			end
		else
			TargetNameLabel.Text = "Target: None"
			DistanceLabel.Text = "Distance: --"
		end
	end)
end
PhysicsLoop()

	humanoid.JumpPower = normalJump
	workspace.Gravity = normalGravity

		end
	end
end

-- Aplicar efecto
local function applyEffect(symbol)
	resetEffects()
	if symbol == "⚡" then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = fastSpeed
	elseif symbol == "🤡" then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = slowSpeed
	elseif symbol == "🦘" then
		humanoid.JumpPower = highJump
	elseif symbol == "🧱" then

	elseif symbol == "👻" then

			end
		end
	elseif symbol == "🔥" then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = fastSpeed
		humanoid.JumpPower = highJump
	end
end

-- 🎰 Animación de giro con detención automática
local function spinSlots()
	local results = {"❔","❔","❔"}
	local duration = 2.5
	local startTime = os.clock()
	local finished = false

	while not finished do
		local elapsed = os.clock() - startTime
		local progress = elapsed / duration
		local delayTime = math.clamp(0.05 + progress * 0.2, 0.05, 0.25)

		for i = 1, 3 do
			if results[i] == "❔" then
				labels[i].Text = symbols[math.random(#symbols)]
			end
		end

		-- Detener gradualmente
		if elapsed >= duration * 0.4 and results[1] == "❔" then results[1] = labels[1].Text end
		if elapsed >= duration * 0.7 and results[2] == "❔" then results[2] = labels[2].Text end
		if elapsed >= duration * 1.0 and results[3] == "❔" then results[3] = labels[3].Text end

		if results[1] ~= "❔" and results[2] ~= "❔" and results[3] ~= "❔" then
			finished = true
		end

		task.wait(delayTime)
	end
